init_hook: echo 'Run: mise exec ruby@3 -- bundle install to install Jekyll dependencies'
echo 'Run: mise exec ruby@3 -- bundle exec jekyll serve to start the development server'

serve: mise exec ruby@3 -- bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --livereload
build: mise exec ruby@3 -- bundle exec jekyll build
test: mise exec ruby@3 -- bundle exec htmlproofer ./_site --disable-external
